meta.title: 胸大胸小别乱穿，这样选合适又有气质
meta.title_en: Pick the Right Fit Whether Your Bust Is Big or Small

scenes.context: 有的衣服只能小胸穿，有的只能大胸穿，有的大小胸都可以穿。选对版型才显气质。
sentences: Some tops only work for a small bust.
The right fit brings out your style.
paraphrase: 用small bust换一种说法
Some tops only work for a small bust.
用fit换一种说法
The right fit brings out your style.
scenes.speak: Some tops only work for a small bust. The right fit brings out your style.

scenes.context: 这种带胸背的包容性比较小，手一掐左右只有一公分对折量。
sentences: This chest panel leaves little room.
左右只有一公分的对折量。
There's only a centimeter of ease on each side.
paraphrase: 用chest panel换一种说法
This chest panel leaves little room.
用centimeter换一种说法
There's only a centimeter of ease on each side.
scenes.speak: This chest panel leaves little room. There's only a centimeter of ease on each side.

scenes.context: 对折量小就只能是A杯或小B杯穿，再丰满点就穿不了；左右捏不出量的只能A杯穿。
sentences: 这种量只能A杯或小B杯穿。
That ease only fits an A or small B cup.
再丰满一点就穿不进去。
paraphrase: 用cup size换一种说法
That ease only fits an A or small B cup.
用fuller换一种说法
Anything fuller won't fit.
scenes.speak: That ease only fits an A or small B cup. Anything fuller won't fit.

scenes.context: 胸大的，比如B以上去选这种，侧面看凸出来很多、左右对折量很充足。
sentences: B cups and up should pick this style.
There's plenty of ease on both sides.
paraphrase: 用B cups换一种说法
B cups and up should pick this style.
用plenty of ease换一种说法
There's plenty of ease on both sides.
scenes.speak: B cups and up should pick this style. There's plenty of ease on both sides.

scenes.context: 这种大胸款就不适合小胸穿，小胸穿它这一块都是空的。
sentences: A small bust leaves this area empty.
Big-bust styles don't suit a small bust.
paraphrase: 用empty换一种说法
A small bust leaves this area empty.
用suit换一种说法
Big-bust styles don't suit a small bust.
scenes.speak: A small bust leaves this area empty. Big-bust styles don't suit a small bust.

scenes.context: 这种大小胸穿都可以，因为胸上围捏了小碎折、胸下围也是，中间背折的量足够多。
sentences: The top gathers into small pleats.
There's plenty of ease across the chest.
paraphrase: 用gathers换一种说法
The top gathers into small pleats.
用ease换一种说法
There's plenty of ease across the chest.
scenes.speak: The top gathers into small pleats. There's plenty of ease across the chest.

scenes.context: 小胸穿这一块整体小气折，小胸显大；大胸中间这个折量就全部顶开，也美观舒适。
sentences: It adds shape to a smaller bust.
大胸穿也能顶开不紧绷。
A bigger bust opens the folds without strain.
paraphrase: 用add shape换一种说法
It adds shape to a smaller bust.
用without strain换一种说法
A bigger bust opens the folds without strain.
scenes.speak: It adds shape to a smaller bust. A bigger bust opens the folds without strain.

scenes.context: 大胸中间这个折量全部顶开，既美观又舒适；选对版型，大小胸都能穿出气质。
sentences: A larger bust opens up all the gathers.
It looks good and feels comfortable.
paraphrase: 用gathers换一种说法
A larger bust opens up all the gathers.
用comfortable换一种说法
It looks good and feels comfortable.
scenes.speak: A larger bust opens up all the gathers. It looks good and feels comfortable.

practice: 这种带胸背包容性很小。
This chest panel leaves little room.
大胸要选对折量充足的。
Bigger busts need plenty of ease on both sides.
A small bust leaves this area empty.
碎折设计大小胸都能穿。
Gathered darts work for both bust sizes.
pitfalls: 先看对折量是否匹配罩杯
充足放量既美观又舒适
